about_the_game:
You will step into the role of a calm and meticulous investigator, delving into the intricate fog of complex cases—unraveling clues, dissecting contradictions, and uncovering the layers of hidden truth.

You’re not just playing a detective—you’re becoming one.

You’ll need to organize evidence, trace clues, and cross-verify information to reconstruct the full logic of each case from fragmented narratives. The game offers a fully immersive, deduction-driven experience built entirely around reasoning and discovery.

More than a classic mystery—it's a multi-layered narrative journey.

Different characters, timelines, and perspectives intertwine to form a complex web of storytelling. A single email, a phone call, or an interrogation transcript might reveal an entirely new, hidden storyline.

And in the end, the truth may be far beyond what you first imagined.

Play it on its own or dive deeper with the previous installment.

Even if you start with this title, you can enjoy a complete and seamless detective experience. But for those who have played the earlier game, deeper connections await—familiar faces return, hidden events echo across time, and past choices may quietly shape the course of new stories.
